build.configuration: Set BUILD_DIAGNOSTIC = False for this original pair; the current True setting builds the separate trace pair described in offline-investigation.json
notes: The production EXE and DLL were built, not merely syntax-checked
No tests, application launches, DLL injections, or runtime edits were performed during implementation
PE import inspection found only Windows system and Universal CRT dependencies
Artifacts are local ignored build outputs; tracked sources can rebuild them
The launcher embeds the SHA-256 of its matching DLL; always rebuild both together

usage: Keep synthv-launcher.exe and synthv-runtime.dll beside the original synthv-studio.exe
Open synthv-launcher.exe, read the experimental warning, and type APPLY
Do not interact with the new application window until the launcher reports completion
If startup, injection, or patching fails, the launcher terminates only its newly created application process and reports an error
To use unmodified code, close the application and launch synthv-studio.exe directly
Removing the launcher and companion DLL removes this launch route; no installed-EXE restoration is necessary
mechanism: Refuse concurrent launchers and existing Synthesizer V processes
Hold read-only file locks while checking the original EXE and companion DLL fingerprints and starting the app
Launch the original EXE in a kill-on-close startup job without debugger attachment or privilege elevation
Wait for an idle application window and five consecutive matches of all seven 32-byte runtime guards
Find the actual image base from the new process module list; all patch addresses are RVAs, not disk offsets
Resolve the remote LoadLibraryW address from its owning system module and load the explicit companion DLL path
Start the exported worker and wait until it has passed Windows thread initialization before suspending other application threads
Verify thread ownership, pause other threads, and retry if an instruction pointer lies inside a replacement span
Recheck every guard, apply six edits, read them back, flush instruction caches, and restore page protections
On any patch failure, do not resume the paused application threads; discard the newly created process instead
On success, resume threads, wait for worker exit, release the startup job kill policy, and leave the DLL loaded for the countdown hook

patches.intended_effect: Return -1 from the traced note-cap getter
patches.evidence: The RFC traces this return into the positive-cap note-muting condition
patches.limitation: Also replaces the getter's original 0 result for missing or other voice states; it does not load a voice or supply engine authorization

patches.intended_effect: Return false from the traced editor-trial-expiry getter
patches.evidence: The original function compares trial type, validity timestamp, and a separate expiry byte
patches.limitation: Does not establish voicebank expiry coverage or change the underlying entitlement record

patches.intended_effect: Return editor state 2 from the traced editor-type getter
patches.evidence: The original matching-record path returns 1 for trial and 2 for non-trial; its caller uses 2 for the unrestricted note-cap decision
patches.limitation: Does not synthesize license records, activation responses, keys, or engine data

patches.intended_effect: Skip the identified branch that appends a trial track to the export restriction list
patches.evidence: A type-1 comparison precedes the branch; its destination appends the current track index
patches.limitation: The complete export consumer chain and actual rendered audio remain unvalidated

patches.intended_effect: Skip the identified branch collecting a trial voice for the rendering-disabled warning
patches.evidence: The type-1 branch leads to collection of the voice name; fallthrough retains the normal cleanup path
patches.limitation: Suppressing this warning does not establish successful rendering

patches.replacement: FF 25 00 00 00 00 followed by the 64-bit companion hook address and one NOP
patches.intended_effect: Construct the English string Trial expires in ∞ days in the caller-supplied output object
patches.evidence: The original function uses RDX as the output-string address and returns that address in RAX; both direct callers consume and release that string
patches.constructor_evidence: The guarded constructor accepts an output object, character buffer, and length, allocates using the application allocator, and invokes the UTF-8 decoding path at RVA 0x808A30
patches.limitation: The user confirms the infinity text appears; the replacement always returns English text and bypasses localization

outstanding_rfc_requirements: Offline rendering, including fresh starts without a connection
Voicebank expiry handling and engine-side authorization
Remaining trial restrictions and raw or inlined entitlement-state consumers
Refresh behavior for decisions cached before runtime patch installation
Playback, export, saving, reopening, and behavior with licensed voices
Compatibility with the application's integrity and anti-injection behavior
side_effect_scope: The patch code does not write the installed EXE, voicebank files, activation stores, network responses, registry settings, or system clock
The original application may still perform its own normal disk and network operations
Ending the process removes code edits but does not undo normal application settings or project changes
Byte and hash checks establish code identity, not functional correctness or completion of the RFC
The original on-disk patch_synthv.py utility is unchanged and still has no on-disk patch manifest
